surface: result, when a draft is offered
intent: Rewrite line 2 only of the existing augment-draft coachmark; line 1 is unchanged and stays as shipped (three augments offered per cleared ticket, one holds for the run). Line 2 currently states the cadence (three tickets a day, a clean day banks three picks) plus what CONFIG and BOOST each do; the cadence fact is correct and verified, keep it. What has to go: any implication that the augment pool can run dry. It cannot anymore: boost bays cap ownership at 3 to 5 and there are only 4 config augments total, so the player can never hold more than bays-plus-4 at once, and a full bay swaps a new BOOST in rather than refusing it, so the draft always has something left to offer. If there is room after stating the cadence, a brief note that a BOOST pick swaps into a full bay rather than freely stacking is welcome, but that rule gets its own coachmark (boost-swap) the moment it first actually happens, so it is fine to leave out here if line 2 is tight. Do not restate exact augment counts (do not say '18' or similar), the catalog size is not the point and changes independently of this coachmark.
constraints: 2 lines total for the whole moment (both lines count against the cap), 160 chars each, no em or en dashes, terminal voice. Line 1 should be reproduced verbatim or near-verbatim from the shipped copy unless you see a reason to touch it.
title: AUGMENT DRAFT
lines: Clearing a ticket offers three augments. Pick one and it holds for the rest of the run.
Three tickets a day, so a clean day banks three picks. CONFIG unlocks a mode, BOOST bends the economy. A full bay swaps instead of blocking.
